items.title: 新增 story_sync_main 命令和门禁
items.context: 命令只能在对应 story worktree 中运行，检查当前分支/工作区状态，执行 git merge main，并只自动处理当前 story metadata 冲突。

happy.desc: 在 story worktree 中 dry-run story_sync_main 时，只输出 merge main 计划、当前分支和将保护的 story metadata 路径，不修改 git 状态

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/story-sync-main.json:4 WHY dry-run case asserts plan output plus head/status unchanged severity:high

edge.desc: confirm 执行时 main 只与当前 story index/checklist 冲突，命令自动用 --ours 保留 story metadata 并提交 merge

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/story-sync-main.json:22 WHY metadata conflict case exercises confirm auto --ours merge severity:high

adversarial.desc: 在非对应 story worktree 或 main 分支运行 story_sync_main，会失败并提示正确 worktree 路径

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/story-sync-main.json:40 WHY wrong cwd case verifies worktree gate rejects unsafe execution severity:high

items.title: 冲突处理只保护当前 story metadata
items.context: 对 .koala/story/actives/<storyId>/index.json/checklist.json 等当前 story artifact 自动 checkout --ours；其它冲突保留并提示用户处理。

happy.desc: main 与 story 分支只在 .koala/story/actives/<storyId>/index.json phase 冲突时，sync 后 phase 保持 story 分支当前值

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/story-sync-main.json:58 WHY phase stays TEST after sync, proving story branch index wins severity:high

edge.desc: 当前 story metadata 目录下多个 JSON 冲突时，全部自动 --ours 并列入输出

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/story-sync-main.json:76 WHY multiple current story metadata conflicts are listed and resolved severity:high

adversarial.desc: 另一个 story 的 metadata 冲突不会被自动解决，会作为 unresolved conflict 停下

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/story-sync-main.json:94 WHY other story metadata remains unresolved instead of being auto-resolved severity:high

items.title: 增加 story_sync_main fixture 覆盖
items.context: 覆盖 metadata-only 冲突自动解决、真实源码冲突仍失败、非 worktree/cwd 错误提示等场景。

happy.desc: fixture 覆盖 metadata-only 冲突自动解决和 merge 成功

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/story-sync-main.json:112 WHY fixture self-check confirms metadata-only sync coverage exists severity:medium

edge.desc: fixture 覆盖源码文件冲突时命令失败且保留冲突文件给用户处理

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/story-sync-main.json:126 WHY source conflict case confirms non-story conflicts remain visible severity:high

adversarial.desc: fixture 覆盖 dry-run 不产生 MERGE_HEAD、不改变 HEAD、不写工作区

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/story-sync-main.json:144 WHY dry-run self-check confirms no mutation assertions exist severity:medium
